verdict.headline: This NDA imposes perpetual, one-sided secrecy obligations with no legal exceptions and exposes you to full indemnity liability.
summary: The agreement defines confidential information to include public facts and excludes all standard disclosure exceptions.
Your secrecy duties last forever, and only the vendor has the right to terminate the contract.
You are required to indemnify the vendor for legal costs on a full indemnity basis without any liability cap.

verdict.headline: This tenancy imposes severe risks including non-refundable deposits, uncapped rent rises, structural repair burdens, and re-entry.
summary: The contract permits the landlord to retain the RM20,400 deposit at its sole discretion and to impose uncapped rent increases on 14 days' notice.
The tenant is held responsible for major structural repairs and faces immediate self-help re-entry and goods detention after 7 days of unpaid rent.
Early exit before month 24 triggers an unmitigated liability for all remaining rent across the 3-year term.

findings.title: Non-refundable security deposit at landlord discretion
findings.quote: The Security Deposit shall be non-refundable at the Landlord's discretion on the expiry or earlier termination of this Agreement, and the Landlord is not required to give reasons or to account for its decision.
findings.why_risky: The landlord can arbitrarily forfeit your RM20,400 security deposit without explanation. Under clause 4.2, the landlord has sole discretion to refuse a refund at expiry or termination even if you have complied with every obligation.
findings.standard: Commercial tenancy security deposits (usually 2 to 3 months' rent) should be refundable within 14 to 30 days after handover, with deductions strictly limited to proven arrears or damage beyond fair wear and tear.
findings.suggested_ask: Please make the security deposit refundable within 21 days of handover back, with deductions limited to unpaid rent and utilities and damage beyond fair wear and tear, each shown by a written list or receipts.

findings.suggested_ask: Please limit the tenant's repair duty to day-to-day upkeep and damage the tenant causes; the landlord keeps the structure and the main services, with repairs done within 14 days of notice.
